map.临界角只在什么情况出现？: When does a critical angle appear?
map.临界角只存在于光从光密介质射向光疏介质（n₁>n₂，如水中看空气）；此时入射角超: A critical angle exists only when light travels from an optically denser medium into a rarer one (n₁ > n₂, such as looking at air from under water); beyond θc the light is totally reflected and no refracted ray exists. Going from rare to dense (such as air into water) gives refraction at every angle and no total reflection.
map.钻石折射率 n=2.42，对空气临界角仅 arcsin(1/2.42)=24.4: Diamond has n = 2.42, so its critical angle to air is only arcsin(1/2.42) = 24.4°; even a small angle of incidence causes total internal reflection, so light reflects many times inside before leaving through the top face, and with high dispersion this produces fire. Window glass at n ≈ 1.52 has a critical angle of about 41° and rarely reflects totally.
